ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, in parallelogram $ABCD$, $AB = 3.5\,cm$, $BC = 5\,cm$, $AE$ bisects $\angle BAD$, $CF\parallel AE$, what is the length of $AF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is a parallelogram, \\
$\therefore$ AD $\parallel$ BC, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle$DAE = $\angle$AEB, \\
Since AE $\parallel$ CF, \\
$\therefore$ quadrilateral AECF is a parallelogram, \\
$\therefore$ AF = CE, \\
Since AE bisects $\angle$BAD, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle$BAE = $\angle$EAD, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle$BAE = $\angle$AEB, \\
$\therefore$ AB = BE = 3.5\text{cm}, \\
$\therefore$ EC = BC - BE = 5 - 3.5 = 1.5\text{cm}, \\
$\therefore$ AF = \boxed{1.5}\text{cm}

method.method_draft: Describe the diagram first: ABCD is drawn as a parallelogram with A and D on the top side, B and C on the bottom side; E lies on segment BC, F lies on segment AD, segment AE is drawn from A to E, and segment CF is drawn from C to F parallel to AE. Use the text data AB=3.5 cm, BC=5 cm, AE bisects angle BAD, and CF parallel AE. Since ABCD is a parallelogram, AD is parallel to BC, so angle EAD equals angle AEB by alternate interior angles. Because AE bisects angle BAD, angle BAE equals angle EAD. Thus angle BAE equals angle AEB, so triangle ABE is isosceles and BE=AB=3.5 cm. Then EC=BC-BE=5-3.5=1.5 cm. 推理：因为 ABCD 是平行四边形，所以 AD ∥ BC。E 在 BC 上，因此 BE 与 AD 平行，由平行线内错角可得 ∠EAD = ∠AEB。又因为 AE 平分 ∠BAD，所以 ∠BAE = ∠EAD。于是 ∠BAE = ∠AEB，三角形 ABE 为等腰三角形，所以 BE = AB = 3.5 cm。由于 BC = 5 cm，所以 EC = BC - BE = 5 - 3.5 = 1.5 cm。再看四边形 AECF，AF 在 AD 上，EC 在 BC 上，而 AD ∥ BC，所以 AF ∥ EC；同时已知 AE ∥ CF，因此 AECF 是平行四边形。平行四边形对边相等，所以 AF = EC = 1.5 cm。
